name: talent-graph
install: bun install && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive node_modules/.bin/agent-browser install --with-deps && sudo ln -sfn "$PWD/node_modules/.bin/agent-browser" /usr/local/bin/agent-browser
start: if ! agent-browser --version >/dev/null 2>&1; then bun install && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive node_modules/.bin/agent-browser install --with-deps && sudo ln -sfn "$PWD/node_modules/.bin/agent-browser" /usr/local/bin/agent-browser; fi
